not_run.reason: Health snapshot scoping, source resolution, sanitization, and malformed eviction are deterministic UI/session boundaries; mocked request/client results cover them without credentials, network access, or cost.

actionlint was not installed; no dependency was added for this narrow workflow change. PyYAML contract parsing, local gates, and the real GitHub push/PR jobs provide the configured validation layers.
Recommendation and runtime fallback eligibility are deterministic pure profile/candidate decisions; direct matrices cover the affected behavior without credentials or cost.
Cached candidate reconciliation is deterministic local artifact selection; real two-process disk fixtures cover the stale-discovery boundary without credentials or cost.

Prior-round context loading and fail-before-write ordering are deterministic local resume boundaries; fake agents plus temporary invalid-UTF8 and read-error fixtures cover the affected behavior without credentials or cost.
Discovery iteration and artifact-write boundaries are deterministic and covered with fake SDK pagers plus temporary write failures; no credential, cost, or external service is required.
Literature Survey Mode is deterministic and provider-free; a real src.main subprocess with the actual run lock covers the affected interrupt boundary without credentials or cost.
Judge parsing and runner invalid-score handling are deterministic local boundaries; direct parser and fake-agent round-loop tests cover the affected behavior without credentials or cost.

Analysis and comparison consume existing local artifacts without provider calls; direct, API, writer, and real module subprocess matrices cover the affected metric boundary without credentials or cost.

Resume eligibility is decided from local checkpoint metadata before any runner or agent stage; provider-free direct and real module subprocess tests cover the affected boundary without credentials or cost.

No native Windows runner was available; reparse-point classification and component-level static behavior are unit-tested/reviewed, while active replacement is explicitly outside the Windows guarantee.
ARA-004 is a provider-free package-resource and mock-workflow change; isolated mock, source, wheel, and sdist controls exercise the affected behavior without credentials or cost.
No native Windows runner was available; Windows target-exists semantics received static/mocked review, while Darwin ran locally and Linux ran in Python 3.10/3.13 GitHub Actions.
The temporary sdist contains local owner/group metadata and nondeterministic generated timestamps; ARA-018 license policy and ARA-026 archive normalization remain unresolved.
